texts.li: [victim] {A_nameDef} knows the face at the head of this war party. {X_nameDef} left {A_objective} bleeding in the dirt once, and has come back with {ENEMY} to finish the job.
[killed] {X_nameDef}, who killed {DEAD}, is leading a war party of {ENEMY} against the colony. {DEAD} has not been forgotten here.
[maimed] A war party of {ENEMY} is on its way, led by {X_nameDef}, the one who maimed {DEAD}.
[fled] {X_nameDef} got away after the last fight, and has spent the time since gathering a war party of {ENEMY}. They are marching on the colony now.
[hunts] {X_nameDef} of {ENEMY} swore to hunt down {DEAD}, and never stopped looking. Now {X_nameDef} has found the colony, and brought a war party.
[robbed] {X_nameDef} hasn't forgotten the money. {ENEMY} are marching on the colony with {X_nameDef} at their head, asking for {DEAD} by name.
[betrayed] {X_nameDef} turned the crew against {DEAD} and had {DEAD} put off the ship. Now {X_nameDef} has followed {DEAD} here, with {ENEMY} at {X_possessive} back.
[enslaved] {X_nameDef}, who once held {DEAD} in chains, is coming back with {ENEMY} to take back what {X_pronoun} still thinks is {X_possessive}.
[victim,lowtech] {A_nameDef} heard the war horns first and knew them. {X_nameDef}, who left {A_objective} in the dirt last time, is at the head of a war party of {ENEMY}, painted for a fight.

[victim,!lowtech] {A_nameDef} picked out the voice on the open channel before anyone else did. {X_nameDef}, who left {A_objective} on the ground last time, is leading {ENEMY} back to finish what {X_pronoun} started.
[downed] {X_nameDef}, who put {DEAD} on the ground in the last fight, is back at the head of a war party of {ENEMY}. {DEAD} hasn't forgotten, and neither has {X_nameDef}.
[killed,lowtech] Scouts saw the war party a long way off: {ENEMY}, with {X_nameDef} at the front. The colony buried {DEAD} because of {X_nameDef}.
[killed,!lowtech] The motion sensors caught them at the edge of the colony's land: {ENEMY}, and walking in front, {X_nameDef}, who killed {DEAD}. The colony knows the name.
[maimed] {X_nameDef}, who left {DEAD} with wounds that never healed right, is back with {ENEMY}. {DEAD} still feels the old injury on cold mornings.
[fled] {X_nameDef} ran from the colony's guns last time, and has had a long while to brood on it. {ENEMY} are with {X_objective} now, and they're coming.
{ENEMY} have not forgotten {DEAD}, who died in the colony's hands. A war party has come to settle the matter.
[lowtech] {DEAD} died a prisoner here. Among {ENEMY}, a death like that is paid for in blood, and {DEAD}'s kin have come with a war party to collect.

[!lowtech] {ENEMY} are marching on the colony, broadcasting the same name over and over on an open channel. It belongs to {DEAD}, who died a prisoner here, and they've come to make someone pay for it.
{DEAD} died a prisoner here, and {ENEMY} have come for an answer. Their war party is already on the colony's land.
[tribal] The drums started at dusk. {ENEMY} have come for {DEAD}, who died as the colony's prisoner, and they won't go home until someone has paid for it.
[winter] {ENEMY} have marched through the snow to settle the matter of {DEAD}, who died in the colony's hands. They mean to be paid in blood.

[lowtech] Empty hands raised high, a young soldier in the colors of {ENEMY} came stumbling toward the colony and stopped well short of the gate. {X_nameDef} has deserted, and {ENEMY} hang deserters.\n\n{X_nameDef} begs to be taken in. {A_nameDef} went out to {X_objective} first, and thinks the fear is real.

[!lowtech] Hands up, weapon slung, a figure in {ENEMY} gear is waiting out past the fields to be noticed. {X_nameDef} has had enough of {ENEMY}, and {ENEMY} are not the forgiving kind. {X_nameDef} asks for shelter, and {A_nameDef}, who went out to talk, believes the story.

{X_nameDef}, who fought for {ENEMY} until three days ago, is hiding in the scrub near the colony and has asked {A_nameDef} for help. Deserters don't live long among {ENEMY}. {X_nameDef} asks for shelter, and swears {X_pronoun} is done with fighting for anyone but friends.

[winter] {X_nameDef} came out of the snow in a torn {ENEMY} coat, hands raised and shaking with cold, and says {X_pronoun} walked away from {ENEMY} in the night and has been sleeping in ditches since. {A_nameDef} brought out a blanket before anyone had decided anything.

[tribal] A young warrior of {ENEMY} laid a spear at the colony's gate and sat down beside it. {X_nameDef} has left the war band, and {ENEMY} don't let anyone leave. {X_nameDef} asks to be taken in, and hasn't touched the spear since.

[trait:Kind] {A_nameDef} found {X_nameDef} at the edge of the fields, a soldier of {ENEMY} barely older than a child, hiding from {X_possessive} own side. {X_nameDef} ran from {ENEMY} two nights ago and begs for shelter. {A_nameDef} has already given {X_objective} {A_possessive} coat.

li.label: Take {X_objective} in
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} is one of the colony now. With any luck, {ENEMY} will never learn where {X_pronoun} went.

outcomes.li: [trait:Kind] {A_nameDef} finds {X_nameDef} a bed and a coat that doesn't carry {ENEMY}'s colors.
{X_nameDef} burns {X_possessive} old colors in the cookfire that night, one strip at a time.

li.riskOutcome: {X_nameDef} is one of us now, but {ENEMY} won't let it go. They'll come looking for {X_objective} within a few days.

li.label: {ENEMY} want their deserter
li.text: {ENEMY} have come for {X_nameDef}, who ran from them to us.

li.label: Send {X_objective} on
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} goes back out into the wild, alone.

outcomes.li: {A_nameDef} gives {X_nameDef} a day's food and points out the road. {X_nameDef} goes without looking back.
[trait:Kind] {A_nameDef} slips {X_nameDef} a loaf and a blanket, and watches {X_objective} out of sight.

li.label: Hand {X_objective} back to {ENEMY}
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} is marched back to {ENEMY} under guard, begging the whole way. {ENEMY} are pleased with the colony.

li.label: Take {X_objective} in, and put it about that {X_pronoun} drowned
li.outcome: {B_nameDef} took {X_nameDef}'s old coat, torn and muddied, to the nearest market and told a sad story about the river. {X_nameDef} is one of us now, and as far as anyone knows, dead.
li.riskOutcome: {B_nameDef} told the story of the drowning well, but {ENEMY} didn't believe a word of it. {X_nameDef} is one of us now, and {ENEMY} will come looking within a few days.

li.reason: Nobody here could tell that story and be believed.

li.label: {ENEMY} want their deserter
li.text: {ENEMY} never believed {X_nameDef} drowned. They've come for {X_objective}.
